verdict:
NO ENTRY IN THE COMMON, AND THE NEXT EVENT IS ALMOST CERTAINLY A DILUTIVE RAISE.

THE SCREEN PREMISE IS A CATEGORY ERROR. CDZI is tagged Utilities / Water Supply; it has no rate base, no regulated revenue, and no utility cash flows - it is a pre-revenue project-finance developer. 'Excess drawdown vs the Utilities median' compares it to nothing. The -52% is fully name-specific and traceable to its own numbers.

THE NUMBERS ARE TERMINAL WITHOUT NEW MONEY. Cash $5.3M at 6/30/26, down from $16.5M at 3/31 (-68% in one quarter); working capital $1.6M; stockholders' equity $4.7M from $23.3M at year-end; H1 operating outflow -$12.2M. Against that: $120M of total debt at a 15.4% effective rate with the Heerema senior secured, the $20M 7%-PIK convert (conversion $5.30, far OTM at $3.47) and the $16M junior convert ALL maturing 6/30/2027. The up-to-$400M MWI equity is still 'late-stage due diligence' - no definitive agreement - and the capital mix was already re-cut from 50/50 to 30% equity / 70% public financing 'to address higher construction costs'. Q2 revenue printed $0.979M vs $4.126M LY. The March raise ($20M at $3.50) was burned inside one quarter and the tape now sits below that placement price, so the next raise prices at or under $3.47. The genuinely notable fact is that real milestones DID land - BLM 50-year ROW, $403.3M of GMP contracts, CAIDD MOU, 21,275 AFY contracted - and the stock fell INTO them: the market is pricing the funding gap, not the project.

THE INSTRUMENT FINDING IS THE ONE THING WORTH KEEPING. The 8.875% Series A preferred CDZIP closed $22.49 - 91% of par, near the top of its own 52-week range, ~9.8% yield - while the common is -52%. The market is pricing DILUTION AND EQUITY-VALUE TRANSFER, not insolvency. That is a coherent, informative cross-instrument read: if this exposure is ever wanted, the preferred is the instrument, and the common is the funding-event residual. It does not make the common court-worthy; it makes the common the wrong line on the ticket.

GATE DESIGN (beta-carrier test): a price gate on the common is meaningless here - the binding variable is the FUNDING EVENT, not the price. Any fill below $3.47 pre-raise is by definition the market front-running the raise; the level self-invalidates. Event gates only.

PRINT-CLOCK NOTE: the binding near-term event is not the ~11/12 print - it is the assumed SEPTEMBER 2026 notice-to-proceed on the $403.3M GMP contracts, which requires the MWI equity and the $194M WIFIA loan to close inside weeks. That clock is running now.
blue_ruling: TRIAGE-ONLY - no benches convened. Court-worthiness 4/10, below threshold, and I concur: the balance sheet speaks for itself and a court would confirm 'flat until MWI closes' without changing sizing.
reopen_gates: EVENT (the only gate that matters): a DEFINITIVE MWI equity agreement with a disclosed cash contribution to Cadiz - not 'late-stage due diligence'. Re-court the COMMON only after this prints, at whatever price then exists; re-look at the PREFERRED on the same event with fresh eyes.
EVENT: WIFIA $194M loan closing - the second leg the September notice-to-proceed requires. Either leg closing alone is insufficient; the triage's 30/70 capital-mix re-cut means both must land.

EVENT (expected, and it is the entry setup, not a warning): the next equity raise PRINTS at or below the $3.47 tape. Per the response taxonomy this is the only moment the common becomes analyzable - underwrite post-raise with the new share count and runway, never ahead of it.

DATA (cheap, pre-court): a session with SEC access re-reads Note 1 (going-concern language) and the debt footnote of the 8/13 10-Q directly - the triage only had search-indexed text of the going-concern paragraph. Also date-stamp and verify the 13.7%-of-float short-interest figure before anyone treats the bear side as uncrowded or crowded.

INSTRUMENT (sibling question, cheaper than a court): a standalone CDZIP screen - coverage of the 8.875% preferred dividend through a construction period, and whether the preferred survives the 6/30/2027 wall senior to the dilution. If yes, CDZIP at ~9.8% is the risk-priced way to hold the asset question.
